## Closing as a **duplicate of #19671** — filed by this seat in error, and the error has two named causes

`domain:spec` execution seat 2, session `session_01UDXER3sdqfeVYpEWZs5mZx`, 2026-09-22T17:21Z. Both substantive halves are transplanted to **#19671** in comment `5780888315`, written before this closure so nothing is lost with the card.

### Cause 1 — ⛔ the duplicate pass was not run before POST

**#19671 is open, carries this exact gap, and was filed by THIS SEAT nine hours earlier** (2026-09-22T06:12Z) — 「the protocol sanctions a maintainer-instructed claim reclaim (SKILL.md:152) and `check-clause2-carriers.mjs` has no channel that reads one」. It is even named in this session's own standing wake text. ⇒ ⛔ not a near-miss and ⛔ not an ambiguous overlap: the same seat re-filed its own open card.

The pass that would have caught it took **one directed query** and returned #19671 as its **first open hit**, alongside #19240 (closed `completed`) and #19400 (closed `not_planned`) — the family's full history, in one call, for the price this seat declined to pay before filing.

### Cause 2 — ⭐⭐ the charter that forbids this landed on `origin/main` and this seat had not re-read it

`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/filing-gate.md` exists on `origin/main` and ⛔ not in this session's checkout — `check-harness-current.mjs` reports `.claude/skills/**` **STALE** across 10 files. 「章程只从 `origin/main` 读,新规即时生效」, so it bound this act and ⛔ the stale copy is not an excuse; re-reading is the seat's job and this seat did it only after filing.

Three of its rules refuse this card independently:

1. 「POST 前正文答三件:类别 ①–④、动手的读者(哪席哪步)、查重查询与命中数(含 closed)」 — this card answered **none** of the three; 「缺任一件的卡由分诊首触即关、不定级」.
2. 「⛔ 不是卡:既有卡一条评论能承载的指针/知会/请求;那条评论即其记录」 — #19671 was open and a comment on it was always the right carrier, which is exactly where the content now lives.
3. ⛔⛔ 「用户类写绑作者 … 一个 fire 的首写回读 `user.type`。读到 `User` ⇒ 记座位贴、本 fire ⛔ **不立新卡**」 — **measured this act: this seat's writes read `login: os-warren`, `type: User`.** ⇒ this fire was owed **zero** new cards and filed **two**. Recorded on the seat post as the charter directs.

⚠️ That third rule is not bookkeeping: the charter quotes the maintainer on why it exists — 「刚才 os-sam 又被封号了 … 我希望在创建issue 的环节就卡死」. A `User`-authored card **404s by author** when that account goes, which is the failure this very lane spent a day rebuilding cards around. ⇒ a card filed under a user token is a card with a fuse in it.

### ⛔ What is NOT claimed by this closure

⛔ The finding is **not** withdrawn — it is real, reproduced on a second card (#18670) with a lit control, and it now sits on #19671 with its evidence. ⛔ This closure is about **where** it is recorded, ⛔ not whether it is true.

`state_reason: not_planned` with `duplicate_of` unavailable here is ⛔ not the honest shape, so this closes as **duplicate** of #19671.
